# What's working now — aggregate patterns

**The derived scorecard.** Regenerated by `/ps:post-pulse` after each run from the
records in `posts.jsonl`. The raw data is the source of truth; this file is the
cross-post math on top of it, in plain language, so `/ps:post` can draft *strategy*
(which register, which CTA, how long) without recomputing 54 records mid-draft.

This is not `examples.md`. `examples.md` teaches the **shape** of one good post;
this file teaches **what to write and where the skill's own rules disagree with the
data.** Read both before drafting.

> Regenerated 2026-10-23 (window widened to 2026-08-27→2026-10-23 because the last
> pulse was 57 days ago; 7 new posts plus a re-measure of 7 July/August posts). 54
> LinkedIn posts, 0 Twitter/X (no X posts since 2025-11-07). Several August records had
> cross-wired URLs and `posted_at` dates off by 1–11 days; both were corrected from the
> activity URNs this run, which shifts the day-of-week table. Cells with n<4 are
> directional only.

**Baseline:** median engagement rate **2.17%** (avg 2.24%), across 48 posts with
visible impressions. Field-average engagement (reactions+comments+reposts) is **61.9**
(down from 67: the 7 new posts average 25).

## Pillar — which register to write in (STRONG signal)

| Pillar                | Avg eng | Avg comments | n  |
|-----------------------|--------:|-------------:|---:|
| operators-journal     |   83.1  |   10.4       |  9 |
| educational-tactical  |   71.3  |   15.6       |  9 |
| industry-take         |   62.6  |    8.9       | 15 |
| build-in-public       |   48.3  |    4.5       | 21 |

→ **RULE (4th pulse in a row):** build-in-public is still the weakest pillar and still
  the most-posted one: 4 of the 7 new posts, 21 of 54 overall. The window had **zero
  operators-journal posts**, the strongest pillar. The DR field-notes register (rain,
  dozens of execs) is what pulls comments, and it stopped this window.

## CTA — how to close (STRONG signal)

| CTA                 | Avg eng | n  |
|---------------------|--------:|---:|
| dm-advisory         |   97.8  | 10 |
| github              |   68.8  |  6 |
| none                |   51.6  | 23 |
| newsletter          |   46.3  |  3 |
| engagement-question |   43.6  |  9 |
| (karma-waitlist 121, discord 57: n≤2) | | |

→ **CONTRADICTION, now held across 4 pulses (07-11, 07-17, 08-27, 10-23) and getting
  wider:** engagement-question is now the **lowest** CTA with a real sample. This
  window's two question closes ("Agree?", "Ask me anything!") drew **0 comments
  each**. dm-advisory still pulls about 2× more. **Applied 2026-10-23:** `/ps:post` no
  longer defaults to an engagement question; Operator's Journal defaults to dm-advisory.

## Length (MODERATE signal)

| Bucket          | Avg eng | n  |
|-----------------|--------:|---:|
| 400–800 chars   |   67.4  | 23 |
| 800+ chars      |   60.2  | 17 |
| <400 chars      |   55.0  | 14 |

→ **RULE:** 400–800 is still the best bucket (4th pulse). Short posts dropped to last
  because this window added four caption-only media posts (video, carousel, "Agree?")
  that each scored 11–30. A one-line caption on a video or document is not a "short post"
  win. **Applied 2026-10-23:** `/ps:post` now defaults LinkedIn to 400–800 chars.

## Outliers worth studying

- **Top post of the window:** `ln-2026-10-22-meet-roomr-replacing-asterisk`: 48 eng and
  9 comments in its first day (2,085 imp). It's a build-in-public post, but it reads
  like a confession ("For as long as I can remember, I've wanted to stop using
  Asterisk") and it has a technical `⟡` spec list. Re-measure next pulse before
  calling it a win.
- **Best ER with real reach:** `ln-2026-09-29-detailed-records-collections` at **3.7%**
  (30 eng / 806 imp) from a two-sentence caption on a media post. Second-best ER in
  the store, behind `vertical-voice-ai-niche` (3.8%).
- **First-customer milestone** (`ln-2026-09-27-first-qcobro-customer`, 40 eng, 1,603
  imp) promised a reveal "in a few days". That follow-up hasn't been posted. It's an
  open loop worth closing with a post.

## Growth curves — what the re-measure showed (NEW, STRONG)

All 7 re-measured July/August posts are **flat on engagement after week one**: +0 to +2
eng across 7–9 weeks, with impressions up only 2–12%. The only big mover was the post
captured 1 hour after publishing (166 → 1,474 imp). → **RULE for the pulse itself:** a
first snapshot taken ≥3 days after posting is close to final. Re-measures are worth it
mainly for posts captured within their first 48 hours.

## Open questions / data gaps

- **The activity feed misses posts.** `/recent-activity/` skipped everything between 2w
  and 3mo old, including two posts in this window. **Use creator analytics → Top posts
  (past 90 days) as the post list**, and its "View analytics" URNs as canonical URLs.
  Its impressions column is 90-day-windowed, so read metrics on the post page.
- **Cadence dropped:** 7 posts in 57 days, including a 30-day gap (08-27 → 09-27).
- **`top_comments`** now in 9 records' latest snapshot (up from 3).
- **No Twitter/X data.** All patterns are LinkedIn-only.

---

### How this file is regenerated

`/ps:post-pulse` recomputes this after each sweep from `posts.jsonl`: averages by
pillar / CTA / length / day-of-week, the ER baseline, the current outliers, and any
place a data pattern contradicts a rule in `/ps:post` (surface those explicitly — they
are the highest-value output; if a contradiction holds across ≥2 pulses, propose the
rule edit for Pedro's approval). Keep it short (~1 screen); it is a summary, not an
archive. Treat every cell with n<4 as directional.
